snippet.title: A Story of Questions - Official Gameplay Trailer | Indie Horror Showcase 2025
snippet.description:
Someone isn't letting you leave. All you are permitted to do is solve puzzles (if you can), inspect and interact with your surroundings, and then decide what to do (if you dare). Each decision is final, so think carefully... there is more going on behind the scenes in this supernatural mystery.
